slides.title: THE PROBLEM
slides.subtitle: The Global Water Crisis in Agriculture
slides.content:
Agriculture accounts for approximately 70% of global freshwater withdrawals, a figure that is unsustainable given increasing population demands and climate change. Inefficient irrigation practices lead to massive water waste, particularly in regions facing severe water scarcity.
Depleting aquifers and rivers
Rising operational costs for farmers
Reduced crop yields due to water stress
Environmental degradation and soil salinization
